stories.name: Guided Onboarding Experience
stories.rationale: Introduced an AI-powered guided experience to walk users through key steps of the platform setup.

stories.name: ACE Partner Program Integration
stories.rationale: Built out the full ACE partner workflow including connecting opportunities to CRM deals, refreshing contacts at push time, a consolidated review UI, and a modal editor for Primary Needs from AWS.

stories.name: CRM Stage Mapping & Data Quality
stories.rationale: Cleaned up CRM stage mappings and used LLM-powered gap-filling to improve crosswalk data accuracy.

stories.name: AI Alliances Assistant Access Control
stories.rationale: Restricted the AI Alliances Assistant navigation to super admins to prevent unauthorized access.

stories.name: Skematic.ai User & Company Management
stories.rationale: Ensured skematic.ai users are properly attached to the Skematic company and added a UI for editing company details.

stories.name: Sidebar & Navigation Improvements
stories.rationale: Fixed an overflowing profile name in the sidebar and moved navigation elements into the navbar for a cleaner layout.

stories.name: Amazon Quick Flows MCP Integration
stories.rationale: Enabled Amazon Quick Flows integration by adding a Playbook MCP server and OAuth2 token endpoint for authentication.

stories.name: Rival-First Onboarding & HubSpot Externalization
stories.rationale: Shipped rival-first onboarding for non-marketplace companies, externalized the HubSpot API, and added rival hard-delete cleanup with batched deletion handling.

stories.name: Batch Deletion Performance Optimization
stories.rationale: Improved platform performance by batching S3 and Pinecone deletes during rival-deletion cleanup to reduce overhead.

stories.name: Outbound CRM Sync Reliability Fix
stories.rationale: Fixed outbound sync reliability by ensuring Company.updatedAt is bumped on field-value writes so changes propagate correctly.
